scope: The relocated archive contains 268 runtime assets and 284 total release files. Only the server runtime artifact changes from R3; all numeric providers, the CLI and profile bytes remain identical. Three API/caller assets are present, hashed, and the actual packaged document checker passes six bounded cases under cp1252 with Unicode filenames, including mixed missing input, invalid recovery and existing-file preservation. These are container checks, not rendered-document qualification. Both real q8192/out32 HTTP requests exercise the early callback and match the original GB10 boundary. The full tool-recovery HTTP suite and final-artifact soak require separate evidence. This package is a test candidate, with performance and long-context release gates still open.
